title: Phoenix Booking Consistency
description: Actionable booking-consistency audit signals. Tenant IDs are shown without names or child data.

panels.title: Audit records in the last 26 hours
panels.description: One record is expected per active tenant. Zero triggers the missing-run alert.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({env="$env",service="server"} |= "booking consistency audit" | json | msg=~"booking consistency audit (passed|found drift)" [26h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Missing pickup projections
panels.description: Actionable: booked care days without a valid effective pickup time.

targets.expr: last_over_time({env="$env",service="server"} |= "booking consistency audit" | json | msg=~"booking consistency audit (passed|found drift)" | keep tenant_id,pickup_projection_missing_days | unwrap pickup_projection_missing_days [26h])

panels.title: Approved children missing required offering
panels.description: Actionable: an approved child has no required, selectable care offering.

targets.expr: last_over_time({env="$env",service="server"} |= "booking consistency audit" | json | msg=~"booking consistency audit (passed|found drift)" | keep tenant_id,approved_without_required_offering | unwrap approved_without_required_offering [26h])

panels.title: Optional offering review
panels.description: Review only: optional offering selection is absent. This does not contribute to total_findings and does not alert.

targets.expr: last_over_time({env="$env",service="server"} |= "booking consistency audit" | json | msg=~"booking consistency audit (passed|found drift)" | keep tenant_id,approved_without_optional_offering | unwrap approved_without_optional_offering [26h])

panels.title: Total actionable findings
panels.description: Sum of missing pickup projections and missing required offerings. Alerts only fire on increases, not on a known baseline.

targets.expr: last_over_time({env="$env",service="server"} |= "booking consistency audit" | json | msg=~"booking consistency audit (passed|found drift)" | keep tenant_id,total_findings | unwrap total_findings [26h])

panels.title: Audit results by tenant and audit date
panels.description: All remaining counters. Lines contain tenant IDs and aggregate counts only.

targets.expr: {env="$env",service="server"} |= "booking consistency audit" | json | msg=~"booking consistency audit (passed|found drift)" | line_format "audit_date={{.audit_date}} tenant_id={{.tenant_id}} pickup_projection_missing_days={{.pickup_projection_missing_days}} approved_without_required_offering={{.approved_without_required_offering}} approved_without_optional_offering={{.approved_without_optional_offering}} total_findings={{.total_findings}}"

{env="$env",service="server"} |~ "booking consistency audit failed|tenant operation failed, continuing to next tenant" | json | level="ERROR" | msg=~"booking consistency audit failed|tenant operation failed, continuing to next tenant" | operation=~"booking-consistency-audit|"
